Vendored browser dependencies for the SFPUC drawing tool.

- Leaflet.draw 1.0.4, from the npm leaflet-draw package. MIT license copied
  from https://github.com/Leaflet/Leaflet.draw/blob/v1.0.4/MIT-LICENSE.md .
  API: https://leaflet.github.io/Leaflet.draw/docs/leaflet-draw-latest.html
- JSZip 3.10.1, from the npm jszip package, distributed under the included
  MIT/GPLv3 dual license. API: https://stuk.github.io/jszip/

Files are served locally; drawing and export make no external service calls.
